name: HITRUST CSF v11
description: Health Information Trust Alliance Common Security Framework — comprehensive, certifiable security framework based on ISO 27001, HIPAA, NIST, PCI DSS, and other standards. Widely adopted in healthcare.

controls.title: Access Control Policy
controls.description: An access control policy shall be established, documented, and reviewed based on business and information security requirements.

controls.title: User Registration and De-registration
controls.description: A formal user registration and de-registration procedure shall be implemented to enable assignment of access rights.

controls.title: Privilege Management
controls.description: The allocation and use of privileges shall be restricted and controlled. Privileged accounts shall be reviewed on a regular basis.

controls.title: User Authentication for External Connections
controls.description: Appropriate authentication methods shall be used to control access by remote users.

controls.title: Risk Management Program
controls.description: Information security risks shall be identified, analyzed, evaluated, and treated using a formal risk management program.

controls.title: Information Security Policy
controls.description: An information security policy document shall be approved by management, published, and communicated to employees and relevant external parties.

controls.title: Information Security Coordination
controls.description: Information security activities shall be co-ordinated by representatives from different parts of the organization with relevant roles and job functions.

controls.title: Confidentiality Agreements
controls.description: Requirements for confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements reflecting the organization's needs for the protection of information shall be identified and regularly reviewed.

controls.title: Contact with Authorities
controls.description: Appropriate contacts with relevant authorities shall be maintained.

controls.title: Inventory of Assets
controls.description: All assets shall be clearly identified and an inventory of all important assets drawn up and maintained.

controls.title: Information Security Awareness, Education, and Training
controls.description: All employees and, where relevant, contractors shall receive appropriate awareness education and training and regular updates in organizational policies and procedures.

controls.title: Audit Logging
controls.description: Audit logs recording user activities, exceptions, faults and information security events shall be produced, kept and regularly reviewed.

controls.title: Monitoring System Use
controls.description: Procedures for monitoring use of information processing facilities shall be established and the results of the monitoring activities reviewed regularly.

controls.title: Input Data Validation
controls.description: Data input to applications shall be validated to ensure that this data is correct and appropriate.
controls.category: 10 Information Systems Acquisition, Development, and Maintenance

controls.title: Control of Operational Software
controls.description: There shall be procedures in place to control the installation of software on operational systems.
controls.category: 10 Information Systems Acquisition, Development, and Maintenance

controls.title: Reporting Information Security Events
controls.description: Information security events shall be reported through appropriate management channels as quickly as possible.

controls.title: Including Information Security in the Business Continuity Management Process
controls.description: A managed process shall be developed and maintained for business continuity throughout the organization that addresses the information security requirements.

controls.title: Identification of Applicable Legislation
controls.description: All relevant statutory, regulatory, and contractual requirements and the organization's approach to meet these requirements shall be explicitly identified, documented, and kept up-to-date.
